name: AMASS
summary: 统一多个动作捕捉数据集的四维人体运动数据库，将不同参数化转换为一致的 SMPL 身体表示，支持长时人体运动预测、生成和交互建模。
summaryEn: A unified 4D human-motion database combining 15 motion-capture datasets in a common SMPL representation for motion prediction, generation, and interaction modeling.
scaleZh: 15 个动作捕捉数据集 · 300+ 名受试者 · 11,000+ 段动作 · 40+ 小时
organizations: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and collaborators
organizationsZh: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所及合作团队
license: AMASS and source-dataset licenses apply; research restrictions may differ
licenseZh: 适用 AMASS 和各来源数据集许可；研究限制可能不同
access: Official project access; registration may be required
accessZh: 官方项目访问；可能需要注册
verdict: 统一四维人体动作数据库
wmNote: 统一身体状态表示和丰富动作多样性适合学习长时人体动力学，但它主要提供运动状态，不包含完整环境观测。
wmNoteEn: A unified body-state representation and diverse motions support long-horizon human dynamics, while full environment observations are not provided.

evidence.sourceTitle: [1904.03278] AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes
evidence.statement: Unifies motion-capture sequences into a common parameterized human-body representation; source and derived motion datasets overlap.
